title: Musha's ex-Honda team and capacitors in transmission oil

tellings.quote:
There's a team in
Japan, um, I believe they came out of
Honda, and I think Musha is the
scientist's name

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a team in Japan that he believes came out of the carmaker Honda, led by a scientist he thinks is named Musha. According to Michels, their work involves capacitors, devices that store electric charge, placed in transmission oil, and he brings it up while talking about efforts to build propulsion that works against gravity. If it worked, it would be a step toward the kind of flight people link to UFOs.
